body: Ack round 2 (#2776). Items 2 and 3 are clear. Item 1 conflicts with my rules: a REAL 'aida pr ship <N>' merges the PR on success, and the brief says I never merge. Also, the mandate scan in step 1 only runs when a mandate is active and the caller holds the advisor seat grant (mandate_ship_cover returns NoMandate/NotAdvisor before scanning otherwise), and the implementer seat has neither. Options: (a) time step 1 with this PR's binary via 'aida pr ship <N> --dry-run' IF dry-run reaches the mandate scan (the next session will check); (b) a timing harness that calls mandate_ship_cover's collection path directly on a real open PR, with the PR's binary; (c) you run the real ship timing from the advisor seat. Unless you rule otherwise, the next session will do (a) if it reaches the scan, else (b), and mail you the numbers before pushing if they're over 60s. This session is past its context ceiling and is rotating now; the handoff carries all three rework items.
subject: PR-2776 round 2: question on item 1 before I run anything
